name: Report to General Kirika
label: Quest
description: Report to General Kirika: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You must be one of General Kirika's new recruits. It's about time you showed up. Bodies wear down quick in the desert.
The dwarves have been getting reinforcements daily, and we can't afford to lose ground in our struggle for resources in Silithus.
Get your instructions from the General. It's not my job to train you, just find you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It's good that you're hear, but there's no time to waste making small talk. You need instructions, and then you need to get out there.
